scientific_claim_ceiling: Synthetic active-particle source-specific propagation benchmark; no claim of biological communication, agency, intelligence, life or consciousness.

source_papers.title: Motion-salience gating shapes information passability in self-propelled collectives
source_papers.key_claim: A bounded intermediate salience-threshold window supports source-linked, temporally outward propagation. Lower thresholds admit background activity; higher thresholds starve group-scale relay. High global order alone does not establish source-specific propagation.
source_papers.accessible_method_detail: The accessible source text describes motion salience as the rate of change of a neighbour's relative bearing. The full exact equation and source data have not been admitted.

source_papers.title: Collective motion of self-propelled particles with selective interactions regulated by Motion Salience Threshold
source_papers.key_claim: Binary active/inactive selective interaction; threshold sweeps can show first-order transitions and hysteresis at low noise and continuous transitions as noise increases.

olI_implementation.gate: admit when within_interaction_range AND salience >= threshold
olI_implementation.status: OLI finite-difference operationalization; not source-faithful until the authors' complete equation, inactive-state dynamics and code/data are inspected
olI_implementation.angular_aliasing: Bearing deltas near pi are explicitly warned as near the angular sampling limit. This warning does not rule out aliasing at faster unsampled rotation rates.

stage_1_OLI_parameter_grid.note: OLI pre-registered extension. Only the source-reported particle/system/threshold/noise settings above are claimed as paper values; burn-in, measurement horizon and 30-seed target are OLI choices.

matched_controls.description: One registered source agent receives a heading pulse; downstream response times and distances are recorded.
Same initial state, seed and random stream but no source pulse; estimates spontaneous/common-driver background activation.
Selective salience gate disabled while preserving the rest of the declared dynamics; tests whether global order alone is sufficient.
Threshold above observed salience range; tests participation starvation.
A shared exogenous field drives multiple agents without direct agent-to-agent interaction; should not count as source-specific relay.
Pulse-source identity is permuted after observing the run; tests source-attribution leakage.

passability_default_criteria.status: OLI provisional engineering thresholds, not values claimed from the paper; tune only on a declared development split then freeze before blind evaluation.

bounded_window_rule.definition: A contiguous run of passing threshold coordinates for one fixed noise level, bounded by at least one failed tested threshold below and one failed tested threshold above.
bounded_window_rule.interpretation: A bounded window is supported only within the tested grid and source-specific acceptance criteria; it is not by itself a thermodynamic phase transition.
bounded_window_rule.aggregation_unit: one independent seed and one (noise, threshold) coordinate
bounded_window_rule.confidence_interval_unit: bootstrap independent seeds, never particle frames or repeated observations as independent samples

anti_leakage_and_observability: All frames from one trajectory and seed remain in the same split.
Never distribute particles from one simulation trajectory across train and test as independent cases.
Pulse and sham use common random numbers and share the same initial configuration.
Use source identity only as a pre-registered intervention label, not as a post-hoc fit feature.
Temporal downsampling and angular wrapping are explicit challenge dimensions.
Report source attribution separately from global order and transfer-entropy-like association.
A common external driver must not be misclassified as direct inter-agent propagation.
